To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the VIP customers of an online shopping mall can be predicted using a model based on decision tree and bagging with decision tree as a base classifier, and that association rules and sequential pattern analysis of the transactions of VIP customers can be utilized to develop CRM strategies for the mall.

VIP customers are more likely to purchase the product of their previous purchase and the products that are purchased by VIP customers in the past are also likely to be purchased by them in the future.
the VIP customers are the most important customers of online shopping malls and that the VIP customers can be identified based on recency, frequency, and monetary value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to use data mining techniques for CRM in an online shopping mall.
the application of association rule and sequential pattern mining to the analysis of online transaction data and to the extraction of useful knowledge.
the development of an effective CRM strategy using data mining techniques.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed CRM strategies are effective in improving the performance of a small-sized online shop.
the proposed CRM strategies are very useful for the online shopping malls.
our model and CRM strategies are useful to the online shopping mall for the improvement of the customer satisfaction and the customer loyalty.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a VIP customer model and CRM strategies based on data mining techniques for an online shopping mall.

the CRM strategies based on association rules, sequential patterns, decision tree and artificial neural network are more useful than the ones based on the recency, frequency, monetary value and decision tree.
the proposed model is able to classify customers into VIP and non-VIP with high precision and recall, and the proposed CRM strategies are effective for the online shopping.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed model and strategies can be applied to other online shopping malls, and the results can be used as a basis for developing more effective CRM strategies.
VIP customers tend to purchase a product that is related to their previous purchase.

the proposed CRM strategies based on association rules can be used to improve the customer satisfaction, customer loyalty and customer retention of the online shopping mall, thereby enhancing its profitability and competitive advantage.
